description: Search published California Values Act transfer counts, Illinois Way Forward Act detainer, warrant, transfer and request reports, or Oregon Sanctuary Promise Act requests and communications. These are agency self-reports. State measures differ and are never added or ranked across states. State is required; agency name, year and result limit are optional. Oregon’s year is the end year of its June–May reporting period. Illinois agency rows are available for 2024; 2023 has statewide figures and a separate non-filer list, not agency appendix rows. A zero is a reported zero, a null is absent from an appendix. “No transfers reported” and “did not file” do not mean “no cooperation”. Never say an agency “violated” a law or acted “illegal” based on these records.

agency.description: Optional case-insensitive agency or public-body name substring, at most 80 characters.

state.description: Required state report: CA, IL or OR. Measures differ and are never added across states.

year.description: Optional report year; Oregon labels its June-to-May period by the ending year.
